summary.text: Eric Weaknecht is a Republican state representative from Pennsylvania House District 5 who took office on December 1, 2024, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A law enforcement officer, he was elected sheriff of Berks County in 2007.

paragraphs.text: Weaknecht attended Kutztown Area High School and the Pennsylvania Sheriff's Academy, and his career experience includes working in law enforcement.
He was elected to serve as the sheriff of Berks County in 2007.
Weaknecht succeeded Barry Jozwiak in District 5.
Democrat Andres Ruben Flammer Santiago is his opponent on the November 3, 2026 ballot.
